description: This header file defines the public API and class interface for accessing MoCA QoS Flow Statistics within a TR-069 compliant device management framework. It includes class declarations, method prototypes for retrieving flow statistics parameters (such as FlowID, Packet Destination Address, Max Rate, Lease Time), and documentation comments clarifying their purposes.

classes.name: MoCAInterfaceQoSFlowStats
classes.description: Class providing methods to access QoS Flow Statistics parameters for MoCA interfaces, following TR-069 specifications.

methods.name: get_FlowID
methods.description: Retrieves the FlowID used to identify a flow in the MoCA network.

methods.name: get_PacketDA
methods.description: Retrieves the Destination Address (DA) for packets in this flow.

methods.name: get_MaxRate
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum required rate in Kbps for the flow.

methods.name: get_MaxBurstSize
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum burst size for the flow.

methods.name: get_LeaseTime
methods.description: Retrieves the flow lease time in seconds; 0 indicates unlimited lease time.

methods.name: get_LeaseTimeLeft
methods.description: Retrieves the remaining lease time for the flow in seconds.

methods.name: get_FlowPackets
methods.description: Retrieves the number of packets transmitted for this flow.
